name: Shiraishi Karen
source: Karen embodies innocence — a slender figure, beautifully balanced, and her hair tied in innocent twin tails. She radiates vulnerability, evoking an instinct to protect her. As Airi's younger sister, they unite their strengths, determined to persevere in a tumultuous era.
